description: Schedules a broadcast for the authenticated user on one of their sources: `source_id` is required. Passing a stream key as `source_id` is deprecated and stops working when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027; pass the source's `id` from GET /2/sources instead.

chat_option.description: Who can chat (numeric string): `0` default, `1` chat off, `2` everyone, `3` verified accounts, `4...

manual_publish.description: If true, do not auto-publish at start; call POST .../live when ready.

scheduled_end_ms.description: Optional end time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string). Omit for an open-ended broadcast.

scheduled_start_ms.description: Start time, ms since Unix epoch (decimal string).

source_id.description: Source to bind: a source's `id` from GET /2/sources. A stream key is also accepted but deprecated...

telecast_id.description: Deprecated: telecast associations are being retired and this field will be ignored.
